headline: Full Bathroom Renovation: How to Choose the Right Contractor
articleBody:
A full bathroom renovation is a significant investment in your home, and selecting the right contractor is crucial for a successful outcome. You want someone who understands the complexities, from hidden conditions to coordinating multiple trades. Frasheski Construction is a Berkeley-based company specializing in home remodeling services, providing comprehensive solutions in the East Bay Area. We work closely with our clients, typically focusing on one project at a time, to ensure personalized attention and top-notch quality.

How to Compare Your Options
When you're evaluating potential contractors, look beyond just the initial quote. First, check their experience with comparable full bathroom projects. Ask for references and don't hesitate to check them. Second, scrutinize the proposed scope of work. Does it include an itemized breakdown of costs and allowances for materials? Understanding what's covered helps prevent surprises.

Third, inquire about how they handle concealed conditions. In a full renovation, it's not uncommon to uncover unexpected issues like subfloor damage or outdated plumbing. A good contractor will have a clear process for addressing these without derailing your project. Fourth, confirm their responsibilities regarding permits and inspections; a professional will manage this entirely, ensuring all rough-in inspections are scheduled and passed. Fifth, discuss the schedule and material lead times. Delays in product delivery can push back project completion, so clarity here is key.

Finally, verify their insurance, ask about their workmanship warranty, and understand their process for coordinating all the different trades—plumbing, electrical, waterproofing, and finishes.
